rationale: Running all three compiled helpers against identical fixtures with the baseline a98c04b3 as a control, claude d198c346 is the only pin that does not orphan an unpushed local-base commit (cursor 64a9e958 and codex 4b17f983 both lose it to an unconditional checkout -B, which codex's own comparison concedes) and the only one besides cursor that still cleans when origin is unreachable, while codex additionally turns a wipe-issue that succeeds on the baseline into a hard throw on a clean clone with no --force remedy; its two real defects — the completion-path batch abort that both peers rightly flag, and a baseSynced label that stays true when the fetch failed or when HEAD stays on a diverged local base — are localized fixes that should adopt codex's batchPolicy split and fetch-result check, whereas the peers' defects are silent loss of committed work and a regression against behavior that works today.
